quality.review_scope: Independently audited main-text sequential CdTe–CdSe nanocrystal growth, purification/specimen branches, pyridine exchange, single-SNCH and 90 wt% hybrid device routes, optical blend controls and Figures 1–9 across main pages 1–6. Cited upstream studies and unavailable SI were not audited. Source conflicts, missing parameters and specimen distinctions remain explicit; this is scoped content acceptance.
missing_fields: Growth atmosphere, degassing pressure, Cd acetate hydration, exact OPA and ODE identities are unresolved.
Per-addition Se stock volume/amount and interval reference points are not explicit.
Purification volumes, centrifugation conditions and number of repetitions are not quantified.
No sample-specific atomic-coordinate file or explicitly named crystal polytype is supplied.
No single full-run timing schedule reconciles all source statements.
conflicts: Growth temperature: Methods p.2 section 2.2 reports 240 °C; Results p.2 section 3.1 reports 250 °C. Unresolved.
Branch sizes: abstract p.1 and Results p.2 report thickness 3–5 nm and length 10–30 nm; Conclusions p.6 reports 3–4 nm and 5–30 nm. Unresolved.

Spectral time origins: Figure 6 plot labels II 45 min and III 75 min, while its caption specifies 15 min reaction after each respective injection; p.3 body describes first addition for 30 min. These are retained as source timing descriptions, not independently resolved schedules.
Absorption coverage: abstract p.1 states 380–780 nm; photovoltaic discussion p.4 states 380–750 nm.
